{"command": "cat > generate_chart.py << 'EOF'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

criteria = list(data['criteria'].keys())
baselines = ['Blenderbot', 'DialoGPT', 'ChatGPT']

# Extract win rates
win_rates = {
    'Blenderbot': [data['criteria'][c]['vs_blenderbot'] for c in criteria],
    'DialoGPT': [data['criteria'][c]['vs_dialogpt'] for c in criteria],
    'ChatGPT': [data['criteria'][c]['vs_chatgpt'] for c in criteria]
}

# Set up the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

x = np.arange(len(criteria))
width = 0.25

# Create grouped bar chart
bars1 = ax.bar(x - width, win_rates['Blenderbot'], width, label='vs. Blenderbot', color='#2ecc71')
bars2 = ax.bar(x, win_rates['DialoGPT'], width, label='vs. DialoGPT', color='#3498db')
bars3 = ax.bar(x + width, win_rates['ChatGPT'], width, label='vs. ChatGPT', color='#e74c3c')

# Add labels and title
ax.set_ylabel('Win Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Dialogue System Win Rates in Pairwise Human Preference Study', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([c.capitalize() for c in criteria], fontsize=11)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2, bars3]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax.annotate(f'{height}%',
                    xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 3),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# Add annotation about key insight
ax.annotate('⚠️ Underperforms ChatGPT on Empathy & Overall\n✅ Outperforms all other baselines',
            xy=(0.5, 0.05), xytext=(0.5, 0.05),
            xycoords='axes fraction',
            fontsize=10,
            ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('win_rate_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print("Chart saved to win_rate_chart.png")
EOF
python generate_chart.py"}

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
import json

# Load data
with open('data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

criteria = list(data['criteria'].keys())
baselines = ['Blenderbot', 'DialoGPT', 'ChatGPT']

# Extract win rates
win_rates = {
    'Blenderbot': [data['criteria'][c]['vs_blenderbot'] for c in criteria],
    'DialoGPT': [data['criteria'][c]['vs_dialogpt'] for c in criteria],
    'ChatGPT': [data['criteria'][c]['vs_chatgpt'] for c in criteria]
}

# Read existing chart and add annotations
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

x = np.arange(len(criteria))
width = 0.25

# Create grouped bar chart
bars1 = ax.bar(x - width, win_rates['Blenderbot'], width, label='vs. Blenderbot', color='#2ecc71')
bars2 = ax.bar(x, win_rates['DialoGPT'], width, label='vs. DialoGPT', color='#3498db')
bars3 = ax.bar(x + width, win_rates['ChatGPT'], width, label='vs. ChatGPT', color='#e74c3c')

# Add labels and title
ax.set_ylabel('Win Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Dialogue System Win Rates in Pairwise Human Preference Study', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([c.capitalize() for c in criteria], fontsize=11)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2, bars3]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax.annotate(f'{height}%',
                    xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 3),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# Add detailed annotation box
annotation_text = """KEY INSIGHTS:
• Outperforms Blenderbot: 61-74% across all criteria
• Outperforms DialoGPT: 67-72% across all criteria  
• Underperforms ChatGPT on Empathy (44%) & Overall (49%)
• Best performance: Empathy vs Blenderbot (74%)
• Weakest performance: Empathy vs ChatGPT (44%)"""

ax.text(0.02, 0.98, annotation_text, transform=ax.transAxes,
        fontsize=10, verticalalignment='top',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='#f0f0f0', edgecolor='#333', alpha=0.8),
        fontfamily='monospace')

# Highlight ChatGPT comparisons with red boxes
for i, criterion in enumerate(criteria):
    chatgpt_rate = win_rates['ChatGPT'][i]
    if chatgpt_rate < 50:  # Underperforming
        rect = patches.Rectangle((x[i] + width - 0.15, 0), width*0.7, 100,
                                 linewidth=2, edgecolor='#e74c3c', facecolor='none', linestyle='--')
        ax.add_patch(rect)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('win_rate_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print("Annotations added to win_rate_chart.png")
EOF
